note: Global site header -- renders: Booking.com logo, language/currency, sign in, register, and fixed service tabs (Stays, Flights, Car rentals, etc.)
Global site footer -- renders: fixed navigation links (Support, Partners, etc.), legal links, and language/currency controls
Cookie consent banner -- renders: operator-authored privacy policy text and fixed action buttons (Accept, Reject, Settings)
Hotel page section tabs -- renders: fixed tab labels (Overview, Availability, Facilities, Policies, Fine print, Reviews)
Booking action bar -- renders: fixed controls for wishlist, share, book now, and price guarantee
Hotel header controls -- renders: fixed action buttons (favorite, share, etc.) surrounding the hotel title
Map widget controls -- renders: fixed 'Show on map' button

Availability section chrome -- renders: fixed 'Availability' heading, date summary, and search controls; subtracts the room availability table which contains seller-defined room names and descriptions
Facilities section -- renders: fixed section headings and standard facility labels (e.g., Free WiFi, Parking) defined by the platform's taxonomy
User survey widget -- renders: operator-authored survey questions and fixed rating options
Policies section -- renders: fixed policy category headings (Check-in, Pets, etc.) and standard policy text
Important information section -- renders: operator-authored standard disclaimers and legal notices
FAQ section -- renders: operator-authored standard questions and answers about the booking process
